knowledge_entries_embedding_metadata_che.name: knowledge_entries_embedding_metadata_check
knowledge_entries_embedding_metadata_che.value: ("knowledge_entries"."embedding" is null and "knowledge_entries"."embedding_model" is null and "knowledge_entries"."embedding_dimensions" is null) or ("knowledge_entries"."embedding" is not null and "knowledge_entries"."embedding_model" is not null and "knowledge_entries"."embedding_dimensions" = 768)

memorable_dates_month_day_check.name: memorable_dates_month_day_check
memorable_dates_month_day_check.value: case when "memorable_dates"."month_day" ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$' then to_char(to_date('2000-' || "memorable_dates"."month_day", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM-DD') = "memorable_dates"."month_day" else false end

publication_metrics_counts_check.name: publication_metrics_counts_check
publication_metrics_counts_check.value: ("publication_metrics"."views" is null or "publication_metrics"."views" >= 0) and ("publication_metrics"."likes" is null or "publication_metrics"."likes" >= 0) and ("publication_metrics"."comments" is null or "publication_metrics"."comments" >= 0) and ("publication_metrics"."shares" is null or "publication_metrics"."shares" >= 0)

news_items_relevance_consistency_check.name: news_items_relevance_consistency_check
news_items_relevance_consistency_check.value: ("news_items"."relevance_status" = 'scored') = ("news_items"."relevance_score" IS NOT NULL AND "news_items"."relevance_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "news_items"."relevance_urgency" IS NOT NULL AND "news_items"."relevance_scored_at" IS NOT NULL)
